title: Stair predicate queues a climb before phase guards finish

impact.description: C may leave climb keys queued or queue both climb and phase while applying phase bookkeeping.

notes: C queues keys as a side effect. The command-returning port has a separate omission tracked in internal issue108; it is not a C-list entry or a claim that the same C queued-key symptom occurs there.

references.description: reported C observation; not an independent validation

reference.description: reported C observation; not an independent validation

reported_sources.text:
Danger levels 3.1, 4.1, 5.1, 6.1 and 8 test
  `(borg_escape_stair() || borg_caution_phase(..)) && ... && (phase spell
  || scroll ...)`. On an up staircase `borg_escape_stair()` already queues
  `<` (and its note) and skips the landing-zone check. If no phase is then
  possible (or the anti-summon timer is <= 50), the `<` stays queued and
  the function goes on to the next tests; if a phase is possible, both the
  `<` and the phase keys are queued and the phase bookkeeping
  (`borg.escapes--`, "Danger Level 3.1" etc.) is applied.

next_at_import: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.
